description: Instagram comments API for AI agents: send the URL of a post or reel and get its comments as JSON: text, time, likes and reply count. Up to 100 comments per call. The commenters' names and handles are not returned. Pay per call in stablecoins; comments you paid for but did not get are refunded.

limit.description: number of comments wanted, 1 to 100 (default 20). A larger value is lowered to 100 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

url.description: URL of an Instagram post or reel, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/p/DdG4RIxIPyf/

name: instagram-comments
title: Comments under an Instagram post
